title: 习近平宣布五年内：为发展中国家提供5000，全球南方将如何受益？
speaker: Xi Jinping

segments.en: This is a major move by China, to answer the call of the global south and unite the international community together to promote vigorously AI development and governance.
segments.zh: 这是中国响应全球南方呼声、团结国际社会共同推动人工智能发展与治理的重大举措。

segments.en: It will be an important milestone in the history of AI development.
segments.zh: 这将是人工智能发展史上的重要里程碑。

segments.en: To further support global AI development, to advance global AI capacity building, I hereby announce that in the next five years, China will provide developing countries with 5,000 opportunities in AI training and seminar programs.
segments.zh: 为进一步支持全球人工智能发展，推进全球人工智能能力建设，我在此宣布，未来五年中国将为发展中国家提供5000个人工智能培训和研讨机会。
